name: Customer
titel: Such a nice and big advent calendar !
text:
I recently picked up this Advent calendar squishy toy Christmas countdown for my daughter as part of her Christmas gifts, and my first impression was definitely a good one! I will say that upon receiving it, I was quite surprised by how big the calendar was and how heavy it actually felt. It definitely feels like there is quite a bit packed inside!

The calendar itself measures approximately 14 inches wide by 9 1/2 inches tall, so it is a really nice size. Just looking at the outside of the calendar is fun—the design is bright, colorful, festive, and exciting. Honestly, it had me wanting to start opening the doors myself just to see what was hiding behind each one!

Since this is going to be a Christmas gift for my daughter, I haven't opened any of the individual doors yet, so I can't comment on the squishy toys themselves at this point. However, based on the size, weight, and overall presentation of the calendar, I am really impressed with my first impression.

I also love the idea of having a different little surprise to open each day leading up to Christmas. It makes the countdown to Christmas that much more exciting and gives kids something fun to look forward to every day. Plus, squishy toys are always a hit, so combining them with an Advent calendar seems like such a cute idea.

The packaging is colorful and festive enough that it already feels like a fun Christmas gift before you even start opening it. I can't wait to see my daughter's reaction when she gets it and starts discovering all of the surprises inside. So far, I am very happy with it and can't wait for December!

name: Customer
titel: A daily lesson in patience disguised as twenty-four tiny squishy toys.
text: This advent calendar is such a fun alternative to the usual chocolate countdown. Each day gives kids another little squishy toy to open, which makes the countdown to Christmas feel much more exciting. I like that the toys can still be played with after the calendar is finished instead of disappearing five seconds after opening the door. The variety keeps kids curious about what is coming next. The squishies are cute, colorful, and fun for sensory play. It would be especially nice for kids who enjoy fidgets or collecting small toys. Twenty-four days also means plenty of chances to practice the nearly impossible childhood skill of waiting until tomorrow. This makes December feel like one long parade of tiny squishy surprises.
